title: Identity verification on Claude
summary: Anthropic has implemented identity verification requirements for Claude users, likely in response to regulatory compliance requirements such as the EU AI Act and various national security considerations around advanced AI systems.
problem_solved: Helps Anthropic comply with evolving AI regulations and ensures responsible deployment of advanced AI systems by verifying user identity.
why_valuable: Represents a significant step in AI governance, setting precedent for how AI companies can meet regulatory requirements while maintaining service availability.
